class Endpoint:
    name: str
    base_url: str
    api_key: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)

    def headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        h = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "text/event-stream"}
        if self.api_key:
            h["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.api_key}"
        return h


@dataclass
class ChatResult:
    ok: bool
    error: str | None = None
    status_code: int | None = None
    ttft_s: float | None = None  # first generated token of any kind (content or reasoning)
    ttft_content_s: float | None = None  # first *visible* content token
    ttft_reasoning_s: float | None = None  # first exposed reasoning token (if streamed)
    last_token_s: float | None = None  # last delta carrying content/reasoning
    total_s: float | None = None  # until the stream closed (includes trailing usage chunk)
    finish_reason: str | None = None
    truncated: bool = False  # finish_reason == "length"
    content: str = ""
    reasoning: str = ""
    prompt_tokens: int | None = None
    completion_tokens: int | None = None
    reasoning_tokens: int | None = None
    chunks: int = 0
    attempts: int = 1  # set by the benchmark retry wrapper
    failed_attempts: list = field(default_factory=list)  # status/error/time of each retry
    observed_s: float | None = None  # wall time seen by the user, incl. retries and backoff

    @property
    def decode_tps(self) -> float | None:
        """Approximate generation rate: completion tokens / (last token - first token).

        Client-observed approximation: the numerator includes tokens delivered with the first
        chunk, and providers that hide reasoning may have generated tokens before the first
        observed event. Only reported for longer generations, because short answers may
        arrive in 1-2 network chunks and make the denominator ~0.
        """
        if not (self.completion_tokens and self.ttft_s is not None and self.last_token_s):
            return None
        gen_time = self.last_token_s - self.ttft_s
        if self.completion_tokens < MIN_TOKENS_FOR_TPS or gen_time < MIN_GEN_TIME_S:
            return None
        return self.completion_tokens / gen_time

    @property
    def e2e_tps(self) -> float | None:
        """Completion tokens / total wall time of the successful attempt (incl. TTFT)."""
        if not (self.completion_tokens and self.total_s):
            return None
        return self.completion_tokens / self.total_s


def _delta_text(delta: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
    content = delta.get("content") or ""

104	def stream_chat(
105	    client: httpx.Client,
106	    endpoint: Endpoint,
107	    model: str,
108	    messages: list[dict],
109	    *,
110	    max_tokens: int = 512,
111	    temperature: float = 0.0,
112	    seed: int | None = 42,
113	    timeout_s: float = 180.0,
114	    clock=time.perf_counter,
115	) -> ChatResult:
116	    body: dict = {
117	        "model": model,
118	        "messages": messages,
119	        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
120	        "temperature": temperature,
121	        "stream": True,
122	        "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
123	    }
124	    if seed is not None:
125	        body["seed"] = seed
126	
127	    def fail(msg: str) -> ChatResult:
128	        result.error = redact(msg, (endpoint.api_key,))[:MAX_ERROR_CHARS]
129	        result.total_s = clock() - t0
130	        return result
131	
132	    result = ChatResult(ok=False)
133	    t0 = clock()
134	    done = False
135	    try:
136	        with client.stream(
137	            "POST",
138	            f"{endpoint.base_url}/chat/completions",
139	            headers=endpoint.headers(),
140	            json=body,
141	            timeout=timeout_s,
142	        ) as resp:
143	            result.status_code = resp.status_code
144	            if resp.status_code != 200:
145	                resp.read()
146	                return fail(f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
147	            for line in resp.iter_lines():
148	                line = line.strip()
149	                if not line.startswith("data:"):
150	                    continue
151	                data = line[5:].strip()
152	                if data == "[DONE]":
153	                    done = True
154	                    break
155	                chunk = json.loads(data)
156	                if not isinstance(chunk, dict):
157	                    return fail("protocol error: SSE event is not a JSON object")
158	                if chunk.get("error"):
159	                    return fail(f"stream error: {json.dumps(chunk['error'])}")
160	                result.chunks += 1
161	                usage = chunk.get("usage")
162	                if usage:
163	                    result.prompt_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens")
164	                    result.completion_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens")
165	                    details = usage.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}
166	                    result.reasoning_tokens = details.get("reasoning_tokens")
167	                for choice in chunk.get("choices") or []:
168	                    content, reasoning = _delta_text(choice.get("delta") or {})
169	                    now = clock() - t0 if (content or reasoning) else None
170	                    if now is not None:
171	                        result.ttft_s = now if result.ttft_s is None else result.ttft_s
172	                        result.last_token_s = now
173	                    if content and result.ttft_content_s is None:
174	                        result.ttft_content_s = now
175	                    if reasoning and result.ttft_reasoning_s is None:
176	                        result.ttft_reasoning_s = now
177	                    result.content += content
178	                    result.reasoning += reasoning
179	                    if choice.get("finish_reason"):
180	                        result.finish_reason = choice["finish_reason"]
181	    except (httpx.HTTPError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
182	        return fail(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
183	
184	    if not (done or result.finish_reason):
185	        return fail("protocol error: stream ended without [DONE] or finish_reason")
186	    if not (result.content or result.reasoning):
187	        return fail("protocol error: no content generated")
188	    # Defense in depth: model output is persisted, so scrub anything key-shaped.
189	    result.content = redact(result.content, (endpoint.api_key,))
190	    result.reasoning = redact(result.reasoning, (endpoint.api_key,))
191	    result.truncated = result.finish_reason == "length"
192	    result.total_s = clock() - t0
193	    result.ok = True
194	    return result

`stream_chat()` in `src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:104-194` does the actual timing: `t0 = clock()` is set before the request, and for each streamed SSE delta, if it carries content/reasoning text, `now = clock() - t0` is recorded — the first such timestamp sets `result.ttft_s` (time-to-first-token; separate `ttft_content_s`/`ttft_reasoning_s` variants track first visible-content vs first reasoning token), and the latest is kept in `result.last_token_s`. `total_s` is set to `clock() - t0` once the stream finishes.

These raw fields live on `ChatResult` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:52-94`), which exposes two derived rate properties:
- `.decode_tps()` (`llm.py:73-87`) — `completion_tokens / (last_token_s - ttft_s)`, i.e. generation rate excluding TTFT; returns `None` below `MIN_TOKENS_FOR_TPS`/`MIN_GEN_TIME_S` to avoid noisy short-answer ratios.
- `.e2e_tps()` (`llm.py:89-94`) — `completion_tokens / total_s`, i.e. end-to-end rate including TTFT.

The benchmark driver, `_record()` in `src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:205` (called from `run()` at `bench.py:141`), reads both `.decode_tps` and `.e2e_tps` off each `ChatResult` to aggregate into the report produced by `summarize()`/`to_markdown()`.
